# youtrack_project (Resource)

Manages a YouTrack project. Destroying this resource deletes the project including all of its issues.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "youtrack_user" "owner" {
  login = "jane.doe"
}

resource "youtrack_project" "support" {
  name             = "Support"
  short_name       = "SUP"
  leader_id        = data.youtrack_user.owner.id
  description      = "Customer support tickets"
  reply_to_email   = "support@example.com"
  project_template = "kanban"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `leader_id` (String) Database ID of the user who owns the project.
- `name` (String) Name of the project.
- `short_name` (String) Short name (ID) of the project, used as prefix for issue IDs.

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the project is archived.
- `description` (String) Description shown on the project overview.
- `from_email` (String) Sender address for notifications of this project. Uses the server default if not set.
- `project_template` (String) Template the project is created from, either `scrum` or `kanban`. Only used when the project is created, later changes are ignored.
- `reply_to_email` (String) Reply-to address for notifications of this project.
- `starting_number` (Number) Number of the first issue. Only used when the project is created, later changes are ignored.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Database ID of the project.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import youtrack_project.support 0-29
```
